scope: Offline recording import and kinematic command-path validation; no ROS execution, motor publishing, physics simulation or hardware validation.
full_front_right_export: Refused: first joint sample arrives0.898591383s after first foot sample;43initial foot samples lack a joint within50ms.

timing.method: minimum FK error within receipt window; nearest receipt tie-break; foot topic is unstamped

actual_recording_validation.interpolation: piecewise-linear body-frame feet; sequential bounded strict IK at80Hz or finer
actual_recording_validation.simulated_command_path_scope: 40Hz replay with ideal measured joints following previous command, entry starts at first recorded pose, then finite playback and terminal hold
actual_recording_validation.interpretation: Front-right channel is almost stationary; its entire recorded motion lies within the0.1mm IK tolerance, so ideal simulated commands remain unchanged. This verifies conversion/guards, not a moving physical replay.

review_fixes: Validate recording frame and units before any relabeling.
Require finite positive timing limits, full named joint arrays, and consistent acquisition/receipt clock progress.
Keep one continuous IK branch across offline segment boundaries.
Use monotonic replay time; retain contact-pause phase when enabled.
Bound actual online joint target steps by15rad/s times the smaller of actual interval and one40Hz control period; reject scheduler catch-up, branch jumps and entry jumps via existing fail-stop.
Decode existing MCAP offline without ROS initialization or bag playback; explicit trim provenance preserves exclusions.

Associate a derived foot sample with minimum FK error within the unchanged50ms receipt window, nearest-receipt tie-break, and monotonically ordered joint acquisition. Save matched timestamps; this corrects asynchronous topic delay without relaxing2mm geometric consistency.
limitations: Foot messages have no acquisition stamps; MCAP log/receipt alignment is approximate.
15rad/s and2s entry are engineering bounds, not validated robot performance.
Current limits are the model bounds; installed class driver may clamp more tightly.
Recorded joint positions seed/validate IK; playback tracks the foot path and need not exactly reproduce recorded joint angles.
The online guard rejects an unsuitable actual start or branch instead of claiming every entry is feasible.
Single-leg front_right replay is supported; coordinated four-leg replay is not claimed.

moving_back_right_wave.export: Refused: recorded joint outside model bounds; no output file created and no clipping applied.
moving_back_right_wave.kinematic_alignment: Nearest receipt alone had39samples over2mm FK residual; every moving sample had an exact FK match within50ms. After correcting association the separate joint-bound gate still rejects the motion.
moving_back_right_wave.controller_scope: Current ik.yaml is front-right only; a rear-right recording cannot be sent through it.
